en.title: HyperFrames vs Remotion for AI Video Agents (2026)
en.description: HyperFrames vs Remotion with Claude Code and Codex: HTML and GSAP vs React, Apache 2.0 vs Remotion's company licence, rendering and skills, November 2026.
en.h1: HyperFrames vs Remotion: which to use with an AI coding agent
en.lede: HyperFrames and Remotion both turn code into MP4 video and both ship agent skills for Claude Code and Codex. HyperFrames uses HTML, CSS and GSAP under Apache 2.0. Remotion uses React and TypeScript, and it is free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people, with paid licences above that (terms checked on 16 November 2026).

blocks.text: Comparison at a glance

head: HyperFrames
Remotion
rows: What you write
HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with timing set by data attributes and a paused animation timeline
React and TypeScript components that read the current frame number
Licence
Apache 2.0
Remotion's own licence: free for individuals and for-profit companies of up to 3 employees; paid above that
Cost for a company with 4 or more people
No licence fee. HeyGen-hosted voices, avatars and cloud rendering bill through HeyGen accounts
Creators $25 per month per seat. Automators $0.01 per render with a $100 monthly minimum. Enterprise from $500 per month
Local rendering
`npx hyperframes render`; needs Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg
`npx remotion render`; H.264 by default, other codecs with `--codec`
Cloud rendering
HyperFrames Cloud, your own AWS Lambda or Google Cloud Run
Remotion Lambda on AWS; Cloud Run is named as an alternative
Agent skills
`npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`, or a Claude Code plugin
`npx skills add remotion-dev/skills`, or `npx remotion skills add` in a project
GSAP
The primary animation runtime
Available through the `@remotion/gsap` package
Existing web material
HTML, CSS and GSAP or Lottie animations usually drop in close to as they are (HyperFrames docs)
Rewritten as React components (HyperFrames docs)

blocks.text: Authoring model

A Remotion video is a React component. The component reads the current frame number with `useCurrentFrame()` and returns what that frame looks like. A three-second title fade is written in frames, for example with `interpolate(frame, [0, 15, 75, 90], [0, 1, 1, 0])` at 30 fps.

A HyperFrames video is an HTML file. Elements carry `data-start`, `data-duration` and `data-track-index` attributes that say when they are on screen, and a GSAP timeline created with `paused: true` says how they move. The timeline is registered on `window.__timelines` under the composition id. The renderer seeks the paused timeline to an exact moment before it captures each frame, so GSAP, Web Animations and Lottie render the same way every time. The same title fade is written in seconds.

HeyGen's own comparison gave Claude Code the same one-paragraph request for a 15-second launch video, once with only Remotion's skills and once with only HyperFrames' skills. One run each, nothing edited afterwards: 12 minutes 30 seconds and 10 TypeScript files for Remotion, 11 minutes 50 seconds and 4 HTML files for HyperFrames. The page states that a single run decides nothing about quality. HeyGen makes HyperFrames, so read it with that in mind.
Licence and cost
Remotion terms below were read on remotion.dev on 16 November 2026. Check the page before you decide, because the licence text says it will change slightly in Remotion 5.0.

items: Free License: individuals, for-profit organisations with up to 3 employees, non-profit organisations, and anyone evaluating Remotion without using it commercially yet. Commercial use is allowed.

Company License, required when you do not qualify for the Free License: Remotion for Creators costs $25 per month per seat, and Remotion for Automators costs $0.01 per render, charged in increments of 1000 renders ($10), with a minimum of $100 per month.
Enterprise License: starting at $500 per month, with custom terms.
AI agents: the Remotion licence FAQ says no Seat is needed for AI agents. Each person who makes videos with Remotion, including by prompting an agent, needs a Seat.
Cloud rendering: the Remotion Lambda page says companies using cloud rendering need a Remotion for Automators licence.

blocks.text: HyperFrames is Apache 2.0 for the framework, CLI and skills. Rendering on your own computer is free and needs no account. The HyperFrames FAQ lists a free Studio app plan and a Pro plan at $25 a month. Fonts, music and footage you add keep their own licences.
Rendering

Both tools render locally from a command line. HyperFrames seeks frames in headless Chrome and encodes them with FFmpeg. Remotion's render command takes a composition id and an output path, and supports h264, h265, av1, vp8, vp9, prores, gif and audio codecs.

For cloud rendering, the HyperFrames docs list HyperFrames Cloud (`npx hyperframes cloud render`), AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run in your own account, plus a Producer package for Node applications. Remotion documents Lambda, which splits a render across many functions and stitches the parts together, and mentions Cloud Run as an alternative.
Agent skills

Remotion's official skills include remotion-best-practices, remotion-create, remotion-markup, remotion-studio, remotion-render, remotion-captions and remotion-license. The docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code and OpenCode among the supported agents.

HyperFrames publishes nine skills. The core set is hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, hyperframes-registry, media-use, reverse-any-video and style-sampling, with figma, slideshow and remotion-to-hyperframes installed on demand. The last one brings Remotion code or footage into HyperFrames and checks the result frame by frame. For Claude Code the docs give `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` followed by `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`. More on this route is in [Claude Code video skills](/guides/claude-code-video-skills/) and [Can Claude make videos?](/guides/can-claude-make-videos/).
GSAP in each tool

GSAP normally runs on the wall clock. HyperFrames builds its compositions around a paused GSAP timeline that the renderer seeks. Remotion needs every frame to be a pure function of `useCurrentFrame()`, and its `@remotion/gsap` package builds a paused GSAP timeline and seeks it to the current frame. The package needs `gsap` installed as a peer dependency and is available from Remotion version 4.0.517.
When to pick which

items: Pick HyperFrames when your team writes HTML, CSS and GSAP, when you want video files that open in a browser, when you have existing web animations to reuse, or when a company of 4 or more people wants no licence fee.
Pick Remotion when your video code belongs in a React and TypeScript codebase, when you reuse React components and data, or when you want the paid support that comes with the Company License.
Pick either for a first video with Claude Code or Codex. Both have official skills, both render locally, and a Remotion project can be converted with the remotion-to-hyperframes skill.

blocks.text: Remotion alternatives

Two other tools make video from code. [Motion Canvas](https://github.com/motion-canvas/motion-canvas) is an MIT-licensed TypeScript library that uses generators to program animations, with an editor for real-time preview. [Revideo](https://github.com/midrender/revideo) is an MIT-licensed rendering engine for creating videos in code; its README says it borrows concepts from Remotion, and scenes are TypeScript generator functions.
HyperFrames films from Motionboard
Motionboard has 38 free recipes, each a film of about 10 seconds made with HyperFrames and GSAP and shown next to the launch film it recreates. Three of them are below.
Install the recipes in Claude Code or Codex with the command below.
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
Frequently asked questions

items: Is Remotion free?

As of 16 November 2026, the Remotion Free License covers individuals, for-profit organisations with up to 3 employees and non-profit organisations, including commercial use. Larger companies need a Company License: Creators at $25 per month per seat, or Automators at $0.01 per render with a $100 monthly minimum. Check remotion.dev/license for current terms.
Is HyperFrames free for commercial use?

The HyperFrames FAQ says the Apache 2.0 licence lets you use, change and distribute HyperFrames, including in commercial work, under its terms. Media you add keeps its own licence. HeyGen-hosted features such as voices, avatars and cloud rendering bill through HeyGen accounts.
Can I use GSAP in Remotion?
Yes. Remotion's `@remotion/gsap` package builds a paused GSAP timeline and seeks it to the current frame. Install it with `npx remotion add @remotion/gsap` and install `gsap` as a peer dependency.
Can I move a Remotion project to HyperFrames?

The HyperFrames repository lists a remotion-to-hyperframes skill for bringing existing video code or footage into HyperFrames, starting with Remotion. It verifies the result frame by frame against the original.

zh.title: HyperFrames 与 Remotion：AI 视频 agent 怎么选（2026）
zh.description: 对比 Claude Code 和 Codex 下的 HyperFrames 与 Remotion：创作方式、许可证、渲染和技能（2026 年 11 月）。
zh.h1: HyperFrames 与 Remotion：配合 AI 编程 agent 该选哪个
zh.lede: HyperFrames 和 Remotion 都能把代码变成 MP4 视频，也都为 Claude Code 和 Codex 提供了 agent 技能。HyperFrames 使用 HTML、CSS 和 GSAP，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。Remotion 使用 React 和 TypeScript，个人和不超过 3 人的公司免费，更大的公司需要付费许可（条款核对于 2026 年 11 月 16 日）。

blocks.text: 对比一览

head: HyperFrames
Remotion
rows: 你写什么
HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，用 data 属性和暂停状态的动画时间线控制时间
读取当前帧号的 React 和 TypeScript 组件
许可证
Apache 2.0
Remotion 自有许可证：个人和不超过 3 名员工的营利组织免费，超出后付费
4 人及以上公司的费用
没有许可费。HeyGen 托管的配音、数字人和云端渲染通过 HeyGen 账号计费
Creators 每席位每月 $25。Automators 每次渲染 $0.01，每月最低 $100。Enterprise 每月 $500 起
本地渲染
`npx hyperframes render`，需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg
`npx remotion render`，默认 H.264，可用 `--codec` 选择其他编码
云端渲染
HyperFrames Cloud、你自己的 AWS Lambda 或 Google Cloud Run
AWS 上的 Remotion Lambda，文档把 Cloud Run 列为替代方案
agent 技能
`npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes`，或 Claude Code 插件
`npx skills add remotion-dev/skills`，项目内可用 `npx remotion skills add`
GSAP
主要动画运行时
通过 `@remotion/gsap` 包使用
已有的网页素材
HTML、CSS 以及 GSAP 或 Lottie 动画通常可以近乎原样放入（HyperFrames 文档）
需要改写成 React 组件（HyperFrames 文档）

blocks.text: 创作方式
Remotion 的视频是一个 React 组件。组件用 `useCurrentFrame()` 读取当前帧号，并返回这一帧的画面。一段三秒的标题淡入淡出按帧来写，例如 30 fps 下的 `interpolate(frame, [0, 15, 75, 90], [0, 1, 1, 0])`。

HyperFrames 的视频是一个 HTML 文件。元素带有 `data-start`、`data-duration` 和 `data-track-index` 属性，说明它们何时出现在画面里，用 `paused: true` 创建的 GSAP 时间线说明它们如何运动。时间线以合成 id 为键注册在 `window.__timelines` 上。渲染器在截取每一帧之前，先把暂停的时间线定位到精确的时刻，所以 GSAP、Web Animations 和 Lottie 每次渲染的结果都相同。同样的标题淡入淡出在这里按秒来写。

HeyGen 自己做过一次对比：给 Claude Code 同一段话，要求做一支 15 秒的发布视频，一次只装 Remotion 的技能，一次只装 HyperFrames 的技能。各跑一次，事后不做修改。Remotion 用了 12 分 30 秒和 10 个 TypeScript 文件，HyperFrames 用了 11 分 50 秒和 4 个 HTML 文件。该页面写明单次运行无法说明质量高低。HyperFrames 由 HeyGen 开发，阅读时请考虑这一点。
许可证与费用
下面的 Remotion 条款读取自 2026 年 11 月 16 日的 remotion.dev。许可证文本提到会在 Remotion 5.0 中略有调整，决定前请再看一遍原页面。

items: Free License：个人、不超过 3 名员工的营利组织、非营利组织，以及尚未商用、仍在评估 Remotion 的人。允许商用。
Company License，不符合 Free License 条件时必须购买：Remotion for Creators 每席位每月 $25，Remotion for Automators 每次渲染 $0.01，按每 1000 次渲染（$10）为单位收费，每月最低 $100。
Enterprise License：每月 $500 起，条款定制。
AI agent：Remotion 许可证 FAQ 写明 AI agent 不需要 Seat。每个用 Remotion 做视频的人，包括通过提示词指挥 agent 的人，都需要一个 Seat。
云端渲染：Remotion Lambda 页面写明，使用云端渲染的公司需要 Remotion for Automators 许可。

blocks.text: HyperFrames 的框架、CLI 和技能采用 Apache 2.0。在自己的电脑上渲染免费，也不需要账号。HyperFrames FAQ 列出了免费的 Studio 应用套餐和每月 $25 的 Pro 套餐。你添加的字体、音乐和素材保留各自的许可证。
渲染
两者都可以用命令行在本地渲染。HyperFrames 在无头 Chrome 里定位帧，再用 FFmpeg 编码。Remotion 的渲染命令接收合成 id 和输出路径，支持 h264、h265、av1、vp8、vp9、prores、gif 以及音频编码。

云端渲染方面，HyperFrames 文档列出了 HyperFrames Cloud（`npx hyperframes cloud render`）、你自己账号里的 AWS Lambda 和 Google Cloud Run，以及面向 Node 应用的 Producer 包。Remotion 文档介绍了 Lambda：它把一次渲染拆给许多函数并行完成，再把各部分拼接起来；文档还提到 Cloud Run 可作为替代。
agent 技能

Remotion 的官方技能包括 remotion-best-practices、remotion-create、remotion-markup、remotion-studio、remotion-render、remotion-captions 和 remotion-license。文档列出的受支持 agent 有 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi Code 和 OpenCode。

HyperFrames 发布九个技能。核心技能是 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、hyperframes-registry、media-use、reverse-any-video 和 style-sampling，figma、slideshow 和 remotion-to-hyperframes 按需安装。最后一个技能把 Remotion 代码或素材带入 HyperFrames，并逐帧核对结果。Claude Code 用户按文档先运行 `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes`，再运行 `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`。这条路线的更多内容见 [Claude Code 视频技能](/guides/claude-code-video-skills/)和 [Claude 能做视频吗？](/guides/can-claude-make-videos/)。
两者中的 GSAP
GSAP 通常按真实时钟运行。HyperFrames 的合成围绕一条由渲染器定位的暂停 GSAP 时间线构建。Remotion 要求每一帧都是 `useCurrentFrame()` 的纯函数，它的 `@remotion/gsap` 包会构建一条暂停的 GSAP 时间线，并把它定位到当前帧。该包需要把 `gsap` 作为对等依赖安装，从 Remotion 4.0.517 版本起提供。
什么时候选哪个

items: 团队写 HTML、CSS 和 GSAP，希望视频文件能在浏览器里打开，手头有可复用的网页动画，或者 4 人及以上的公司不想付许可费时，选 HyperFrames。
视频代码要放进 React 和 TypeScript 代码库，要复用 React 组件和数据，或者需要 Company License 附带的付费支持时，选 Remotion。
用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做第一支视频，两者都可以。两者都有官方技能，都能在本地渲染，Remotion 项目也可以用 remotion-to-hyperframes 技能转换。

blocks.text: Remotion 的其他替代方案

除 HyperFrames 外，还有两种用代码做视频的工具。[Motion Canvas](https://github.com/motion-canvas/motion-canvas) 是 MIT 许可的 TypeScript 库，用生成器编写动画，并带有实时预览的编辑器。[Revideo](https://github.com/midrender/revideo) 是 MIT 许可的代码视频渲染引擎，其 README 说借鉴了 Remotion 的概念，场景是 TypeScript 生成器函数。
Motionboard 的 HyperFrames 影片
Motionboard 有 38 个免费配方，每个都是一支约 10 秒、用 HyperFrames 和 GSAP 制作的影片，并与它所还原的发布会影片并排展示。下面是其中三个。
用下面的命令在 Claude Code 或 Codex 里安装这些配方。
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
常见问题

items: Remotion 免费吗？
截至 2026 年 11 月 16 日，Remotion 的 Free License 覆盖个人、不超过 3 名员工的营利组织和非营利组织，包括商用。更大的公司需要 Company License：Creators 每席位每月 $25，或 Automators 每次渲染 $0.01、每月最低 $100。最新条款请看 remotion.dev/license。
HyperFrames 可以免费商用吗？
HyperFrames FAQ 写明，Apache 2.0 许可证允许在其条款下使用、修改和分发 HyperFrames，包括商业用途。你添加的素材保留各自的许可证。配音、数字人和云端渲染等 HeyGen 托管功能通过 HeyGen 账号计费。
Remotion 里能用 GSAP 吗？
能。Remotion 的 `@remotion/gsap` 包会构建一条暂停的 GSAP 时间线，并把它定位到当前帧。用 `npx remotion add @remotion/gsap` 安装，同时把 `gsap` 作为对等依赖安装。
Remotion 项目能迁移到 HyperFrames 吗？
HyperFrames 仓库列出了 remotion-to-hyperframes 技能，用来把已有的视频代码或素材带入 HyperFrames，首先支持 Remotion。它会逐帧对照原片核对结果。
